name: gtr-smooth-g2-pairs-v1
description: GT-R smooth 변형 캠페인 — G2(SU2) ΔCd 명시 쌍. evaluate_*_domino 스크립트의 --pairs 입력. su2_cd는 각 잡 output/history.csv 최종 행(= rbf_optimization_history 소스, 라벨 규약과 동일). 케이스 NPZ/split은 G3_TEST var/gtr-smooth-loo/splits (recovered/ 사본 참조).

pairs.les_note: v7 main set; sign replicated in 3 configs (-0.0287/-0.0176/-0.0262)
pair-internal grid (plain STL own boxes, baseline recomputed on same grid 0.3588); v5 replication -0.0026

notes: planned-but-unrun variants (uploaded STL만 존재): cabin_narrow_5mm, front_narrow_10/20mm, front_wide_10/20mm, roof_lower_5/20mm — P1 확장 후보
|ΔCd| 최소 0.0019 — G2 수렴 노이즈(1.5e-5)보다 100배 이상 커서 방향 평가 유효
AI 쪽 평가 시 같은 메시를 써야 함: gtr-nismo-latest.stl(419k tri)은 캠페인 baseline STL(512k tri)과 다른 메시

les_campaign.solver: AMR-LBM 3-level standard, 18k samples, free placement, u_inf 0.10, cs_l2 0.16
les_campaign.grids: L0 400x144x144 fixed; refine1/2 frozen from baseline (LES_FIX_REFINE_JSON); rear_wide pair on its own frozen grid (micro-triangle bbox pin destabilized that geometry)
disagreements: roof_lower_10mm (G2 +0.0095 / LES -0.0262, sign stable across 3 configs)

les_campaign_v8_uploads.geometry: Workbench upload STLs, vertex-welded (1554 open edges remain) + union-bbox pinned
les_campaign_v8_uploads.protocol: AMR-LBM 3-level standard, 18k samples, free placement, u_inf 0.10, cs_l2 0.16, refine boxes frozen from baseline
les_campaign_v8_uploads.verdict: only roof_lower_20mm cleared S/N 2; the six small-deformation pairs are indistinguishable from noise
lessons: open-shell geometry raises plateau sd ~4x (0.0035 vs 0.0005 on G2-derived watertight surfaces)
bbox pinning fixes the grid but also freezes the reference area, erasing the frontal-area share of narrow/wide deformations
roof deformations keep signal because they change the wake without changing frontal area
roof_lower is the third independent LES result contradicting G2 on roof-lowering direction
